catalogue: ESCO v1.2.1 (3039 occupations) + CareerAI curated (49 careers, 16 merged into ESCO)
label_note: Manually labelled evaluation profiles for CareerAI. Each profile lists careers from the merged catalogue (ESCO v1.2.1 + CareerAI curated) that a careers adviser would reasonably suggest for that input. Labels were assigned by keyword-searching catalogue titles and reviewing the candidates BEFORE the current ranking algorithm was run on them. This is a small, hand-made test set for regression checking; it is not a statistically representative benchmark, the labels are one person's judgement, and relevant careers missing from a list are counted as irrelevant.
